ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there are inputs B and C, which respectively enter a B-C subnetwork composed of logic gates with small inversion bubbles at the outputs; if the two inputs of a certain gate are connected by the same wire, it is treated as an inverter. The upper middle branch has an internal node marked P. The output of the B-C subnetwork is sent to the upper right into the final A stage; input A enters the final output stage from the upper left, and the output on the right is marked f. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, node P no longer takes the output of its normal driving gate, but is forced to the constant 1. After marking the internal wires in the B-C subnetwork level by level and writing equations by treating bubbled outputs as inversion and tied-input gates as inverters, P=1 makes the upper branch become a constant branch; continuing to propagate backward and simplify, the B-C condition sent to the final A stage is retained as B\overline{C}. The final upper-right output gate represents the inversion after the product of A and this condition, therefore f=\overline{A\cdot B\overline{C}}.

raw_record.question_text: In the following figure, if point \(P\) is stuck at 1, what is the Boolean expression for the output \(f\)?

method.method_draft: First label every visible internal wire in the B-C network. Translate each gate in the image into a Boolean equation, treating gates with output bubbles as inverted outputs and tied-input gates as inverters. Replace the wire marked P by the constant 1, regardless of what its driving gate would normally produce. Propagate this constant through the following gates and simplify the remaining B-C expression feeding the final A stage; the surviving internal condition reduces to B\overline{C}. The final output gate shown at the top right is then the inversion of the product of A with this internal condition, giving f=\overline{A\,B\,\overline{C}}.

method.method_draft: Force the marked point P in the figure to logic 1. Then evaluate the remaining B-C part of the circuit for the four combinations BC=00,01,10,11 by following the displayed wires and gate bubbles. Record the value of the internal signal that reaches the final stage with A. The table has value 1 only for B=1 and C=0, so that internal signal is B\overline{C}. Finally read the top-right output stage as producing the complement of A times that internal signal, hence f=\overline{A\,B\,\overline{C}}.

推理：按照题意把点 P 强制为逻辑 1。然后只考察剩余的 B-C 部分对送到最终 A 级的内部信号的影响。依图中连线和门输出泡逐项检查四种输入：BC=00 时该内部信号为 0；BC=01 时为 0；BC=10 时为 1；BC=11 时为 0。因此这个内部信号只在 B=1 且 C=0 时为 1，即为 B\overline{C}。右上方最终输出级读作对 A 与该内部信号的乘积取反，所以 f=\overline{A\,(B\overline{C})}=\overline{A B \overline{C}}。
